comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: the general-partner case ABOVE the Form 8960 threshold, amounts chosen so the exclusion is observable. Total income 242,000 = wages 230,000 + 1099-INT 2,000 + box 4b 10,000 (Schedule E column (k)); box 14A 10,000 carries the payment into SECA — wages already exceed the 176,100 wage base so only Medicare applies: 9,235 x 2.9% = 268, deductible half 134, AGI 241,866; taxable 226,116; tax 49,420 (rate schedule: 1,192.50 + 4,386 + 12,072.50 + 22,548 + 32% x 28,816); Form 8959 additional Medicare 353 = 270 on wages over 200,000 + 83 on the SE earnings; net investment income 2,000 — the interest ONLY, the 4b payment excluded by IRC 1411(c)(6) because item G is the general-partner box (counted, NII would be 12,000); net investment income tax 76 = 3.8% x min(2,000, 41,866 excess over the 200,000 threshold); total tax 50,117 = 49,420 + 268 + 353 + 76; withholding 40,000 < tax so overpayment is 0. Re-blessed: earlier, line 17 resolved 0 because /agi was Placeholder (the service's scaffold, not the engine) and the 8960 guard read it as incomplete — 50,041 then, 50,117 now, the 76 being exactly the understatement since closed.
